title.zh: 第十六 五行四 地震 山崩 地陷 大風拔樹 螟 牛疫
title.raw: 第十六 五行四 地震 山崩 地陷 大風拔樹 螟 牛疫 Volume 106: Five Elements Part Four

sentences.zh: 志第十六 五行四

translations.literal: Treatise Sixteen: The Five Elements, Part Four.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise Sixteen: The Five Elements, Part Four.

sentences.zh: 地震 山崩 地陷 大风拔树 螟 牛疫

translations.literal: Earthquakes; mountains collapsing; ground subsiding; great winds uprooting trees; stem-borer pests; cattle plague.
translations.idiomatic: This section records earthquakes, landslides, sinkholes, gales that tear up forests, rice-borer infestations, and murrain among cattle.

sentences.zh: 《五行传》曰「治宫室，饰台榭，内淫乱，犯亲戚，侮父兄，则稼穑不成。

translations.literal: The "Treatise on the Five Elements" says: "When one builds palace halls, adorns terraces and pavilions, carries on debauchery within, offends kinsmen, and insults fathers and elder brothers, then sowing and reaping do not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: The Hong fan commentary warns that wasteful palace building, lewd conduct within the harem, and contempt for family undercut the virtue of earth, so the fields yield nothing.

sentences.zh: 」谓土失其性而为灾也。

translations.literal: "—meaning earth loses its proper nature and becomes calamity.
translations.idiomatic: That is, the element of soil is corrupted and disaster follows.

sentences.zh: 又曰：「思心不容，是谓不圣。

translations.literal: It also says: "When reflective thought finds no room, that is called lack of sagacity."
translations.idiomatic: The same text adds that when deliberation is cramped and counsel shut out, the ruler fails the standard of "sagacity."

sentences.zh: 厥咎□，厥罚恒风，厥极凶短折。

translations.literal: Its blame [lacuna in text], its scourge is constant wind, its utmost end is violent early death.
translations.idiomatic: The fault is muddled judgment; the matching scourge is ceaseless wind; the bitter end is untimely death in violence.

sentences.zh: 时则有脂夜之妖，时则有华孽，时则有牛祸，时则有心腹之疴，时则有黄眚、黄祥，惟金、水、木、火□土。

translations.literal: In such seasons there are "fat-of-night" prodigies, flower freaks, cattle calamities, ailments of heart and belly, yellow spectral visitations and yellow auspices—only metal, water, wood, and fire [lacuna] earth.
translations.idiomatic: Such ages bring uncanny night lights, freak blossoms, cattle plagues, diseases of the vitals, and yellow hauntings—while metal, water, wood, and fire encroach on earth.

sentences.zh: 」华孽，刘歆传为蠃虫之孽，谓螟属也。

translations.literal: "Flower freaks"—Liu Xin's tradition classes them with omens among naked soft creatures, meaning the stem-borer kind.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xin grouped these floral prodigies with "soft-bodied" vermin omens—in practice, the rice stem borer.

sentences.zh: 世祖建武二十二年九月，郡国四十二地震，南阳尤甚，地裂压杀人。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the twenty-second year of Jianwu, Emperor Guangwu, forty-two commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes; Nanyang was especially severe—the earth split open and crushed people to death.
translations.idiomatic: Jianwu 22 (46 CE), ninth month: forty-two jurisdictions shook; Nanyang worst, with fissures that swallowed lives.

sentences.zh: 其后武谿蛮夷反，为寇害，至南郡，发荆州诸郡兵，遣武威将军刘尚击之，为夷所围，复发兵赴之，尚遂为所没。

translations.literal: Afterward the Wuxi Man and Yi rebelled, becoming bandit scourges as far as Nanjun; troops from the several commanderies of Jingzhou were mobilized, and General of Martial Might Liu Shang was sent to strike them; he was surrounded by the tribes, troops were sent again to relieve him, and Shang was then lost with his force.
translations.idiomatic: Then the Wuxi tribes rose, raided south to Nanjun, and trapped Liu Shang's relief army—he and his men were wiped out.

sentences.zh: 章帝建初元年三月甲寅，山阳、东平地震。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day jiayin of the first year of Jianchu, Emperor Zhang, Shanyang and Dongping suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Jianchu 1 (76 CE), third month, jiayin: tremors struck Shanyang and Dongping.

sentences.zh: 和帝永元四年六月丙辰，郡国十三地震。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen in the sixth month of the fourth year of Yongyuan, Emperor He, thirteen commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Yongyuan 4 (92 CE), sixth month, bingchen: thirteen provinces quaked.

sentences.zh: 《春秋汉含孳》曰：「女主盛，臣制命，则地动坼，畔震起，山崩沦。

translations.literal: The "Spring and Autumn Han hanzi" says: "When the female ruler flourishes and ministers dictate the mandate, then the earth moves and splits, revolt and quake arise, mountains collapse and sink.
translations.idiomatic: An apocryphon warns that when a woman reigns and ministers usurp authority, the ground shudders, rebels stir, and peaks fall into ruin.

sentences.zh: 」是时，窦太后摄政，兄窦宪专权，将以是受祸也。

translations.literal: "At that time Empress Dowager Dou held the government; her elder brother Dou Xian monopolized power—they were about to receive calamity from this.
translations.idiomatic: The Dou regency and Xian's monopoly on power were the moral fault behind the shock.

sentences.zh: 后五日，诏收宪印绶，兄弟就国，逼迫皆自杀。

translations.literal: Five days later an edict ordered Xian's seals and ribbons seized; the brothers went to their fiefs and were driven to suicide.
translations.idiomatic: Five days after: Xian's credentials were stripped; the brothers were sent to their domains and forced to kill themselves.

sentences.zh: 五年二月戊午，陇西地震。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu in the second month of the fifth year Longxi suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Yongyuan 5, second month, wuwu: Longxi shook.

sentences.zh: 懦说民安土者也，将大动，行大震。

translations.literal: The exegetical gloss says: "The people are those who find peace in the earth; when there is to be great movement, there will be a great earthquake."
translations.idiomatic: Commentators read the omen as meaning that the folk, whose life is bound to the soil, foretell a major convulsion when the ground itself is about to shift.

sentences.zh: 九月，匈奴单于於除鞬叛，遣使发边郡兵讨之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Xiongnu Shanyu Yuchujian rebelled; an envoy was sent to mobilize frontier commandery troops to punish him.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Shanyu Yuchujian turned rebel; border garrisons marched against him.

sentences.zh: 七年九月癸卯，京都地震。

translations.literal: On the day guimao in the ninth month of the seventh year the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Yongyuan 7 (95 CE), ninth month, guimao: Luoyang trembled.

sentences.zh: 儒说奄官无阳施，犹妇人也。

translations.literal: The Ru view says palace attendants have no yang bestowal—they are like women.
translations.idiomatic: Scholars compared eunuchs to women: without "yang" generative force, they were a yin presence at court.

sentences.zh: 是时和帝与中常侍郑众谋夺窦氏权，德之，因任用之，及幸常侍蔡伦，二人始并用权。

translations.literal: At that time Emperor He with Regular Attendant Zheng Zhong plotted to seize the Dou clan's power; he valued Zhong and therefore employed him, and when he favored Regular Attendant Cai Lun, the two began together to wield power.
translations.idiomatic: He had conspired with Zheng Zhong to break the Dous, then raised Zhong and Cai Lun until both eunuchs shared the inner court's power.

sentences.zh: 九年三月庚辰，陇西地震。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen in the third month of the ninth year Longxi suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Yongyuan 9, third month, gengchen: another Longxi quake.

sentences.zh: 闰月，塞外羌犯塞，杀略吏民，使征西将军刘尚击之。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month Qiang beyond the passes violated the frontier, killing and plundering officials and people; General Who Conquers the West Liu Shang was sent to strike them.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month: frontier Qiang raided inward; Liu Shang was ordered west.

sentences.zh: 安帝永初元年，郡国十八地震。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongchu, Emperor An, eighteen commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchu 1 (107 CE): eighteen jurisdictions reported tremors.

sentences.zh: 李固曰：「地者阴也，法当安静。

translations.literal: Li Gu said: "Earth is yin; by principle it ought to be still.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gu argued that soil is yin and should lie quiet beneath the ruler's feet.

sentences.zh: 今乃越阴之职，专阳之政，故应以震动。

translations.literal: Now it oversteps yin's office and monopolizes yang's government; therefore the response is to shake and move.
translations.idiomatic: When yin usurps yang's role—women or ministers ruling in the emperor's stead—the ground answers with convulsions.

sentences.zh: 」是时，邓太后摄政专事，讫建光中，太后崩，安帝乃得制政，于是阴类并胜，西羌乱夏，连十余年。

translations.literal: "At that time Empress Dowager Deng held the government and monopolized affairs; down to the Jianguang years the empress dowager died, and only then could Emperor An control government; then yin categories together prevailed, the Western Qiang threw Xia into turmoil, linked for more than ten years.
translations.idiomatic: Through her death in Jianguang, the Deng regency blocked An from rule; yin forces ran wild, and the Qiang war dragged on for over a decade.

sentences.zh: 二年，郡国十二地震。

translations.literal: The second year: twelve commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchu 2: twelve provinces shook.

sentences.zh: 三年十二月辛酉，郡国九地震。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou in the twelfth month of the third year nine commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchu 3, twelfth month, xinyou: nine jurisdictions quaked.

sentences.zh: 四年三月癸巳，郡国四地震。

translations.literal: On the day guisi in the third month of the fourth year four commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchu 4, third month, guisi: four provinces felt the shock.

sentences.zh: 五年正月丙戌，郡国十地震。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu in the first month of the fifth year ten commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchu 5, first month, bingxu: ten commanderies shook.

sentences.zh: 七年正月壬寅，二月丙午，郡国十八地震。

translations.literal: On the day renyin in the first month of the seventh year and on the day bingwu in the second month eighteen commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchu 7: tremors on renyin in the first month and bingwu in the second—eighteen jurisdictions in all.

sentences.zh: 元初元年，郡国十五地震。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanchu fifteen commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanchu 1 (114 CE): fifteen provinces reported earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 二年十一月庚申，郡国十地震。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen in the eleventh month of the second year ten commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanchu 2, eleventh month, gengshen: ten jurisdictions.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，郡国十地震。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year ten commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanchu 3, second month: ten more.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，郡国九地震。

translations.literal: On the day guimao in the eleventh month nine commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanchu 3, eleventh month, guimao: nine commanderies.

sentences.zh: 四年，郡国十三地震。

translations.literal: The fourth year: thirteen commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanchu 4: thirteen provinces shook.

sentences.zh: 五年，郡国十四地震。

translations.literal: The fifth year: fourteen commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanchu 5: fourteen jurisdictions.

sentences.zh: 六年二月乙巳，京都、郡国四十二地震，或地坼裂，涌水，坏败城郭、民室屋，压杀人。

translations.literal: On the day yisi in the second month of the sixth year the capital and forty-two commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes; in places the earth split open, water gushed up, city walls and commoners' houses were ruined, and people were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanchu 6, second month, yisi: Luoyang and forty-two commanderies convulsed—fissures opened, springs burst through, walls and homes collapsed, and many were buried alive.

sentences.zh: 冬，郡国八地震。

translations.literal: In winter eight commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: That winter eight more provinces trembled.

sentences.zh: 永宁元年，郡国二十三地震。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongning twenty-three commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Yongning 1 (120 CE): twenty-three jurisdictions.

sentences.zh: 建光元年九月己丑，郡国三十五地震，或地坼裂，坏城郭室屋，压杀人。

translations.literal: On the day jichou in the ninth month of the first year of Jianguang thirty-five commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes; in places the earth split open, city walls and houses were ruined, and people were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: Jianguang 1 (121 CE), ninth month, jichou: thirty-five commanderies; ground split, towns ruined, lives lost.

sentences.zh: 是时，安帝不能明察，信宫人及阿母圣等谗言，破坏邓太后家，于是专听信圣及宦者，中常侍江京、樊丰等皆得用权。

translations.literal: At that time Emperor An could not investigate clearly; he believed slander from palace women and his nurse Wang Sheng and the like, ruined Empress Dowager Deng's family, and thereafter listened exclusively to Sheng and the eunuchs—Regular Attendants Jiang Jing, Fan Feng, and others all came to wield power.
translations.idiomatic: An turned on the Dengs on whispered lies from Wang Sheng and the harem, then handed the realm to Jiang Jing, Fan Feng, and their fellow eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 延光元年七月癸卯，京都、郡国十三地震。

translations.literal: On the day guimao in the seventh month of the first year of Yanguang the capital and thirteen commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Yanguang 1 (122 CE), seventh month, guimao: Luoyang and thirteen provinces shook.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申，郡国二十七地震。

translations.literal: On the day wushen in the ninth month twenty-seven commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wushen: twenty-seven jurisdictions.

sentences.zh: 二年，京都、郡国三十二地震。

translations.literal: The second year: the capital and thirty-two commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Yanguang 2: the capital plus thirty-two commanderies quaked.

sentences.zh: 三年，京都、郡国二十三地震。

translations.literal: The third year: the capital and twenty-three commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Yanguang 3: Luoyang and twenty-three provinces.

sentences.zh: 是时，以谗免太尉杨震，废太子。

translations.literal: At that time, on slander Grand Commandant Yang Zhen was dismissed and the heir apparent deposed.
translations.idiomatic: That was the year Yang Zhen was ousted on false charges and the crown prince cast down.

sentences.zh: 四年十一月丁巳，京都、郡国十六地震。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi in the eleventh month of the fourth year the capital and sixteen commanderies and kingdoms suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Yanguang 4, eleventh month, dingsi: the capital and sixteen commanderies.

sentences.zh: 时安帝既崩，阎太后摄政，兄弟阎显等并用事，遂斥安帝子。

translations.literal: At that time Emperor An had already died; Empress Dowager Yan held the government; her brothers Yan Xian and company all managed affairs together, and they therefore cast aside Emperor An's son.
translations.idiomatic: After An's death the Yan brothers, behind their sister's screen, set aside An's own boy from the succession.

sentences.zh: 更征诸国王子，未至，中黄门遂诛显兄弟。

translations.literal: They summoned princes of the various kingdoms afresh; before they arrived, the Yellow Gates executed Xian and his brothers.
translations.idiomatic: They called other princes toward the capital, but eunuchs struck first and slaughtered the Yans before the boys arrived.

sentences.zh: 顺帝永建三年正月丙子，京都、汉阳地震。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi in the first month of the third year of Yongjian, Emperor Shun, the capital and Hanyang suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Yongjian 3 (128 CE), first month, bingzi: Luoyang and Hanyang convulsed.

sentences.zh: 汉阳屋坏杀人，地坼涌水出。

translations.literal: In Hanyang houses collapsed and killed people; the earth split and gushing water came forth.
translations.idiomatic: Hanyang's buildings fell and crushed families; the soil gaped and water jetted from the cracks.

sentences.zh: 是时，顺帝阿母宋娥及中常侍张昉等用权。

translations.literal: At that time Emperor Shun's nurse Song E and Regular Attendant Zhang Fang and others employed power.
translations.idiomatic: Shun's wet nurse Song E and Zhang Fang were pulling the strings.

sentences.zh: 阳嘉二年四月己亥，京都地震，是时，爵号宋娥为山阳君。

translations.literal: On the day jihai in the fourth month of the second year of Yangjia the capital suffered an earthquake; at that time the noble title of Song E was advanced to Lady of Shanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Yangjia 2 (133 CE), fourth month, jihai: Luoyang shook the month Song E was ennobled as Lady of Shanyang.

sentences.zh: 四年十二月甲寅。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin in the twelfth month of the fourth year.
translations.idiomatic: Yangjia 4, twelfth month, jiayin—a date heading the next entry.

sentences.zh: 京都地震。

translations.literal: The capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: The capital trembled.

sentences.zh: 永和二年四月丙申，京都地震。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen in the fourth month of the second year of Yonghe the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Yonghe 2 (137 CE), fourth month, bingshen: Luoyang quaked.

sentences.zh: 是时宋娥构奸诬罔，五月事觉，收印绶，归田里。

translations.literal: At that time Song E framed others with adultery and deceit; in the fifth month the affair was discovered, her seals and ribbons were seized, and she returned to the countryside.
translations.idiomatic: Song's forged charges unraveled in the fifth month; she was stripped of rank and sent home.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯，京都地震。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao in the eleventh month the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, dingmao: another shock under Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 是时，太尉王龚以中常侍张昉等专弄国权，欲奏诛之，时龚宗亲有以杨震行事谏之止云。

translations.literal: At that time Grand Commandant Wang Gong, because Regular Attendants Zhang Fang and others monopolized and toyed with state power, wished to memorialize to execute them; at that time a kinsman of Gong's remonstrated using Yang Zhen's precedent and stopped at that.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Gong wanted the eunuchs dead for usurping authority, but kin talked him down with the memory of Yang Zhen's fatal stand.

sentences.zh: 三年二月乙亥，京都、金城、陇西地震裂，城郭、室屋多坏，压杀人。

translations.literal: On the day yihai in the third month of the third year the capital, Jincheng, and Longxi suffered earthquakes and splitting; many city walls and houses were ruined, and people were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: Yonghe 3, second month, yihai: Luoyang, Jincheng, and Longxi split open; walls and roofs fell and killed many.

sentences.zh: 闰月己酉，京都地震。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou in the intercalary month the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, jiyou: the capital shook again.

sentences.zh: 十月，西羌二千余骑入金城塞，为凉州害。

translations.literal: In the tenth month more than two thousand Western Qiang horsemen entered the Jincheng frontier pass, doing harm to Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: two thousand Qiang riders poured through Jincheng to ravage Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 四年三月乙亥，京都地震。

translations.literal: On the day yihai in the third month of the fourth year the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Yonghe 4, third month, yihai: Luoyang trembled.

sentences.zh: 五年二月戍申，京都地震。

translations.literal: On the day wushen in the second month of the fifth year the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Yonghe 5, second month, wushen: Luoyang shook again.

sentences.zh: 建康元年正月，凉州部郡六地震。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Jiankang six commanderies in the Liangzhou division suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Jiankang 1 (144 CE), first month: six Liangzhou commanderies shook.

sentences.zh: 从去年九月以来至四月，凡百八十地震，山谷坼裂，坏败城寺，伤害人、物。

translations.literal: From the ninth month of the previous year down to the fourth month there were in all one hundred eighty earthquakes; valleys and mountains split open, city monasteries were ruined, and people and goods were injured.
translations.idiomatic: In seven months one hundred eighty shocks cracked the northwest—gorges split, monasteries and towns crumbled.

sentences.zh: 三月，护羌校尉赵冲为叛胡所杀。

translations.literal: In the third month Colonel Who Protects the Qiang Zhao Chong was killed by mutinous Hu.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: Zhao Chong died at the hands of rebel tribesmen.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午，京都地震。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu in the ninth month the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, bingwu: Luoyang quaked.

sentences.zh: 是时，顺帝崩，梁太后摄政，欲为顺帝作陵，制度奢广，多坏吏民冢。

translations.literal: At that time Emperor Shun had died; Empress Dowager Liang held the government; she wished to build a mausoleum for Emperor Shun on a lavish scale, destroying many officials' and commoners' tombs.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang dowager was leveling tombs wholesale to build Shun a grand tomb.

sentences.zh: 尚书栾巴谏事，太后怒。

translations.literal: Secretary Luan Ba remonstrated about the affair; the empress dowager was angry.
translations.idiomatic: Luan Ba protested; she flew into a rage.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，诏书收巴下狱，欲杀之。

translations.literal: On guimao an edict ordered Ba seized and imprisoned, intending to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao she had him jailed to be executed.

sentences.zh: 丙午，地震，于是太后乃出巴，免为庶人。

translations.literal: On bingwu there was an earthquake; thereupon the empress dowager released Ba and dismissed him as a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: When the earth shook on bingwu she freed him and reduced him to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 桓帝建和元年四月庚寅，京都地震。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin in the fourth month of the first year of Jianhe, Emperor Huan, the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Jianhe 1 (147 CE), fourth month, gengyin: Luoyang trembled.

sentences.zh: 九月丁卯，京都地震。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao in the ninth month the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, dingmao: another shock.

sentences.zh: 是时，梁太后摄政，兄冀持权。

translations.literal: At that time Empress Dowager Liang held the government; her elder brother Ji grasped power.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Ji dominated the court behind his sister's regency.

sentences.zh: 至和平元年，太后崩，然冀犹秉政专事，至延熹二年，乃诛灭。

translations.literal: Down to the first year of Heping the empress dowager died, yet Ji still monopolized government and affairs; down to the second year of Yanxi he was then executed and extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: She died in Heping 1, but Ji clung to power until Yanxi 2, when he and his clan were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 三年九月己卯，地震，庚寅又震。

translations.literal: On the day jimao in the ninth month of the third year there was an earthquake; on gengyin there was again a quake.
translations.idiomatic: Yonghe 3, ninth month: the earth shook on jimao and again on gengyin.

sentences.zh: 元嘉元年十一月辛巳，京都地震。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi in the eleventh month of the first year of Yuanjia the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanjia 1 (151 CE), eleventh month, xinsi: Luoyang shook.

sentences.zh: 二年正月丙辰，京都地震。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen in the first month of the second year the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanjia 2, first month, bingchen: another.

sentences.zh: 十月乙亥，京都地震。

translations.literal: On the day yihai in the tenth month the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, yihai: the capital quaked.

sentences.zh: 永兴二年二月癸卯，京都地震。

translations.literal: On the day guimao in the second month of the second year of Yongxing the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Yongxing 2 (154 CE), second month, guimao: Luoyang trembled.

sentences.zh: 永寿二年十二月，京都地震。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the second year of Yongshou the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Yongshou 2 (156 CE), twelfth month: capital shock.

sentences.zh: 延熹四年，京都、右扶风、凉州地震。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yanxi the capital, Youfufeng, and Liangzhou suffered earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: Yanxi 4 (161 CE): tremors from Luoyang west to Youfufeng and Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 五年五月乙亥，京都地震。

translations.literal: On the day yihai in the fifth month of the fifth year the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Yanxi 5, fifth month, yihai: the capital.

sentences.zh: 是时，桓帝与中常侍单超等谋诛除梁冀，听之，并使用事专权。

translations.literal: At that time Emperor Huan with Regular Attendant Shan Chao and others plotted to execute and remove Liang Ji; he listened to them, and they together wielded power and monopolized affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Huan and Shan Chao had just brought down Liang Ji; the eunuchs now ran everything.

sentences.zh: 又邓皇后本小人，性行无恒，苟有颜色，立以为后，后卒坐执左道废，以忧死。

translations.literal: Moreover Empress Deng was originally a petty person; her nature and conduct had no constancy; merely because she had looks she was set up as empress—afterward she finally sat condemned for "left-way" sorcery, was deposed, and died of grief.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Deng had been elevated for her face alone; she ended on charges of witchcraft, stripped of rank, and broken-hearted.

sentences.zh: 八年九月丁未，京都地震。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei in the ninth month of the eighth year the capital suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Yanxi 8, ninth month, dingwei: Luoyang shook.

sentences.zh: 灵帝建宁四年二月癸卯，地震。

translations.literal: On the day guimao in the second month of the fourth year of Jianning, Emperor Ling, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Jianning 4 (171 CE), second month, guimao: tremor.

sentences.zh: 是时，中常侍曹节、王甫等皆专权。

translations.literal: At that time Regular Attendants Cao Jie, Wang Fu, and others all monopolized power.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Jie, Wang Fu, and their circle held the levers of state.

sentences.zh: 熹平二年六月，地震。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year of Xiping there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Xiping 2 (173 CE), sixth month: earthquake.

sentences.zh: 六年十月辛丑，地震。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou in the tenth month of the sixth year there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Xiping 6, tenth month, xinchou: tremor.

sentences.zh: 光和元年二月辛未，地震。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei in the second month of the first year of Guanghe there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Guanghe 1 (178 CE), second month, xinwei: quake.

sentences.zh: 四月丙辰，地震。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen in the fourth month there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, bingchen: another shock.

sentences.zh: 灵帝时宦者专恣。

translations.literal: In Emperor Ling's time eunuchs acted wantonly and without restraint.
translations.idiomatic: Under Ling the palace attendants did as they pleased.

sentences.zh: 二年三月，京兆地震。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year Jingzhao suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Guanghe 2, third month: Jingzhao trembled.

sentences.zh: 三年自秋至明年春，酒泉表氏地八十余动，涌水出，城中官寺民舍皆顿。

translations.literal: From autumn of the third year through the next spring in Jiuquan Bishi the ground moved more than eighty times, gushing water came forth, and official buildings and private houses in the city all collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Guanghe 3–4: Bishi in Jiuquan shook over eighty times from autumn to spring; springs burst through the streets and every structure slumped.

sentences.zh: 县易处，更筑城郭。

translations.literal: The county shifted its site and rebuilt city walls.
translations.idiomatic: The county seat was moved and new walls raised.

sentences.zh: 献帝初平二年六月丙戌，地震。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu in the sixth month of the second year of Chuping, Emperor Xian, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Chuping 2 (191 CE), sixth month, bingxu: the ground shook.

sentences.zh: 兴平元年六月丁丑，地震。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou in the sixth month of the first year of Xingping there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Xingping 1 (194 CE), sixth month, dingchou: the ground shook.

sentences.zh: 和帝永元元年七月，会稽南山崩。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Yongyuan, Emperor He, the southern mountain of Kuaiji collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Yongyuan 1 (89 CE), seventh month: a peak south of Kuaiji gave way.

sentences.zh: 会稽，南方大名山也。

translations.literal: Kuaiji is a great famous mountain of the south.
translations.idiomatic: The Kuaiji range was one of the great southern massifs.

sentences.zh: 京房《易传》曰：「山崩，阴乘阳，弱胜强也。

translations.literal: Jing Fang's "Tradition of the Changes" says: "When mountains collapse, yin rides atop yang; the weak conquers the strong.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Fang read landslides as yin overwhelming yang—the weak unseating the strong.

sentences.zh: 」刘尚以为山阳，君也；

translations.literal: "Liu Shang took mountains to mean the ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shang glossed the mountain as the sovereign.

sentences.zh: 水阴，民也；

translations.literal: Water is yin; the common people.
translations.idiomatic: Water stood for yin, the common folk.

sentences.zh: 君道崩坏，百姓失所也。

translations.literal: The ruler's way collapses and ruins; the hundred surnames lose their place.
translations.idiomatic: When the ruler's course breaks, the people lose their homes.

sentences.zh: 刘歆以为崩犹弛也。

translations.literal: Liu Xin held that "collapse" is like "slackening."
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xin compared a mountain fall to foundations giving way.

sentences.zh: 是时，窦太后摄政，兄窦宪专权。

translations.literal: At that time Empress Dowager Dou held the government; her elder brother Dou Xian monopolized power.
translations.idiomatic: Again the Dou regency: the dowager and Xian held the Han court in their hands.

sentences.zh: 七年七月，赵国易阳地裂。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the seventh year the earth of Yiyang in Zhao commandery split open.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, seventh year: the soil cracked at Yiyang in Zhao.

sentences.zh: 京房《易传》曰：「地裂者，臣下分离，不肯相从也。

translations.literal: Jing Fang's "Tradition of the Changes" says: "When the ground splits, ministers and subordinates separate and refuse to follow one another.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Fang took fissures as ministers pulling apart and defying unity.

sentences.zh: 」是时，南单于众乖离，汉军追讨。

translations.literal: "At that time the Southern Shanyu's followers were rebellious and split away; Han armies pursued and punished them.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Xiongnu host had fractured; imperial troops were in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 十二年夏，闰四月戊辰，南郡秭归山高四百丈崩，填溪，杀百余人。

translations.literal: In the summer of the twelfth year, intercalary fourth month, on the day wuchen, a mountain four hundred zhang high in Zigui, Nan commandery, collapsed, dammed a stream, and killed more than a hundred people.
translations.idiomatic: Yongyuan 12 (100 CE), intercalary fourth month, wuchen: a four-hundred-zhang cliff at Zigui sheared off, blocked a gorge, and buried over a hundred souls.

sentences.zh: 明年冬，巫蛮夷反，遣使募荆州吏民万余人击之。

translations.literal: The next winter the Wu Man and Yi rebelled; an envoy was sent to recruit more than ten thousand clerks and people of Jingzhou to strike them.
translations.idiomatic: Next winter the Wushan tribes rose; the court drafted ten thousand Jingzhou men to fight them.

sentences.zh: 元兴元年五月癸酉，右扶风雍地裂。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou in the fifth month of the first year of Yuanxing the earth of Yong in Youfufeng split open.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanxing 1 (105 CE), fifth month, guiyou: the ground split at Yong in right Fufeng.

sentences.zh: 是后西羌大寇凉州。

translations.literal: Afterward the Western Qiang raided Liangzhou on a great scale.
translations.idiomatic: Then the Western Qiang poured into Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 殇帝延平元年五月壬辰，河东垣山崩。

translations.literal: On the day renchen in the fifth month of the first year of Yanping, Emperor Shang, Mount Yuan in Hedong collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Yanping 1 (106 CE), fifth month, renchen: Mount Yuan in Hedong fell.

sentences.zh: 是时，邓太后专政。

translations.literal: At that time Empress Dowager Deng monopolized government.
translations.idiomatic: The Deng regency still ruled.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，殇帝崩。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn Emperor Shang died.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, eighth month, the infant emperor died.

sentences.zh: 安帝永初元年六月丁巳，河东杨地陷。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi in the sixth month of the first year of Yongchu, Emperor An, the ground subsided at Yang in Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchu 1, sixth month, dingsi: a sinkhole opened at Yang in Hedong.

sentences.zh: 东西百四十步，南北百二十步，深三丈五尺。

translations.literal: One hundred forty paces east–west, one hundred twenty paces north–south, three zhang five chi deep.
translations.idiomatic: It measured 140 by 120 paces and sank nearly forty feet.

sentences.zh: 六年六月壬辰，豫章员谿原山崩，各六十三所。

translations.literal: On the day renchen in the sixth month of the sixth year the Yuanxi plateau in Yuzhang saw mountains collapse—sixty-three places in all.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchu 6, sixth month, renchen: sixty-three slides scarred the Yuanxi highlands in Yuzhang.

sentences.zh: 元初元年三月己卯，日南地坼，长百八十二里。

translations.literal: On the day jimao in the third month of the first year of Yuanchu Rinan's earth split open one hundred eighty-two li.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanchu 1 (114 CE), third month, jimao: a rift 182 li long tore Rinan commandery.

sentences.zh: 其后三年正月，苍梧、郁林、合浦盗贼群起，劫掠吏民。

translations.literal: Three years later, in the first month, bandits rose in swarms in Cangwu, Yulin, and Hepu, plundering officials and people.
translations.idiomatic: Three years on, coastal Guangxi erupted in banditry.

sentences.zh: 二年六月，河南雒阳新城地裂。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year the earth split at Xincheng in Henan, Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanchu 2, sixth month: another fissure at Luoyang's Xincheng district.

sentences.zh: 延光二年七月，丹阳山崩四十七所。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year of Yanguang forty-seven places in Danyang saw mountains collapse.
translations.idiomatic: Yanguang 2 (123 CE), seventh month: forty-seven landslides in Danyang.

sentences.zh: 三年六月庚午，巴都阆中山崩。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu in the sixth month of the third year Mount Langzhong in Ba commandery collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Yanguang 3, sixth month, gengwu: Mount Langzhong in Ba gave way.

sentences.zh: 四年十月丙午，蜀郡越巂山崩，杀四百余人。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu in the tenth month of the fourth year Mount Yuexi in Shu commandery collapsed, killing more than four hundred people.
translations.idiomatic: Yanguang 4, tenth month, bingwu: a Yuexi peak in Shu buried four hundred souls.

sentences.zh: 丙午，天子会日也。

translations.literal: Bingwu is a day when the Son of Heaven holds court.
translations.idiomatic: The almanac marks bingwu as an imperial audience day—doubly ominous.

sentences.zh: 是时，阎太后摄政。

translations.literal: At that time Empress Dowager Yan held the government.
translations.idiomatic: The Yan empress dowager was regent.

sentences.zh: 其十一月，中黄门孙程等杀江京，立顺帝，诛阎后兄弟，明年，阎后崩。

translations.literal: That eleventh month the Yellow Gates Sun Cheng and others killed Jiang Jing and enthroned Emperor Shun; they executed Empress Yan's brothers; the next year the empress dowager Yan died.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: eunuchs led by Sun Cheng murdered Jiang Jing, raised Shun, and wiped out the Yans; the dowager followed her kin to the grave the next year.

sentences.zh: 顺帝阳嘉二年六月丁丑，雒阳宣德亭地坼，长八十五丈，近郊地。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou in the sixth month of the second year of Yangjia the Xuande lodge ground at Luoyang split open, eighty-five zhang long, near the suburban altar.
translations.idiomatic: Yangjia 2 (133 CE), sixth month, dingchou: an eighty-five-zhang crack opened at the Xuande pavilion by the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 时，李固时策，以为「阴类专恣，将有分离之象，所以附郊城者，是上帝示象以诫陛下也。

translations.literal: At that time Li Gu offered a policy memorial, holding that "yin categories act wantonly and there will be signs of separation; that it attaches to the suburban wall means High Heaven is displaying an image to warn Your Majesty.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gu warned that yin forces ran riot and portended a parting of ways; a crack beside the ritual park was Heaven's admonition to the throne.

sentences.zh: 」是时宋娥及中常侍各用权分争，后中常侍张逵、蘧政与大将军梁商争权，为商作飞语，欲陷之。

translations.literal: "At that time Song E and the regular attendants each employed power and quarreled in factions; afterward Regular Attendants Zhang Kui and Qu Zheng contended for power with Grand General Liang Shang; they spread flying rumors about Shang, intending to entrap him.
translations.idiomatic: Song E and the eunuchs feuded; Zhang Kui and Qu Zheng then tried to frame Liang Shang with whisper campaigns.

sentences.zh: 桓帝建和元年四月，郡国六地裂，水涌出，井溢，坏寺屋，杀人。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Jianhe, Emperor Huan, six commanderies saw the earth split; water gushed forth, wells overflowed, monasteries and houses were ruined, and people were killed.
translations.idiomatic: Jianhe 1 (147 CE), fourth month: six jurisdictions split open—springs burst, wells boiled over, buildings fell, and lives were lost.

sentences.zh: 时，梁太后摄政，兄冀枉杀李固、杜乔。

translations.literal: At that time Empress Dowager Liang held the government; her elder brother Ji unjustly killed Li Gu and Du Qiao.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Ji, behind his sister's regency, had murdered Li Gu and Du Qiao.

sentences.zh: 三年，郡国五山崩。

translations.literal: In the third year five commanderies and kingdoms saw mountains collapse.
translations.idiomatic: Jianhe 3: five provinces reported landslides.

sentences.zh: 和平元年七月，广汉梓潼山崩。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Heping Mount Zitong in Guanghan collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Heping 1 (150 CE), seventh month: Zitong mountain in Guanghan fell.

sentences.zh: 永兴二年六月，东海朐山崩。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year of Yongxing Mount Qu in Donghai collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Yongxing 2 (154 CE), sixth month: Mount Qu in Donghai gave way.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月，泰山、琅邪盗贼群起。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter bandits rose in swarms in Mount Tai and Langye.
translations.idiomatic: That winter brigandage flared across Taishan and Langye.

sentences.zh: 永寿三年七月，河东地裂。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year of Yongshou Hedong's earth split open.
translations.idiomatic: Yongshou 3 (157 CE), seventh month: Hedong fissured.

sentences.zh: 时，梁皇后兄冀秉政，桓帝欲自由，内患之。

translations.literal: At that time Empress Liang's elder brother Ji held power; Emperor Huan wished to be free and inwardly worried over him.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Ji still choked the court while Huan schemed to shake free.

sentences.zh: 延熹元年七月乙巳，左冯翊云阳地裂。

translations.literal: On the day yisi in the seventh month of the first year of Yanxi the earth split open at Yunyang in Left Fengyi.
translations.idiomatic: Yanxi 1 (158 CE), seventh month, yisi: Yunyang in left Fengyi cracked.

sentences.zh: 三年五月甲戌，汉中山崩。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu in the fifth month of the third year Mount Han collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Yanxi 3, fifth month, jiaxu: Mount Han in the Hanzhong march collapsed.

sentences.zh: 是时上宠恣中常侍单超等。

translations.literal: At that time the emperor indulged and spoiled Regular Attendants Shan Chao and the like.
translations.idiomatic: Huan was showering favor on Shan Chao and his fellow eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 四年六月庚子，泰山、博尤来山判解。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi in the sixth month of the fourth year Mount Tai and Mount Youlai in Bo split apart.
translations.idiomatic: Yanxi 4, sixth month, gengzi: Tai Mountain and the Youlai ridge near Bo town sundered.

sentences.zh: 八年六月丙辰，缑氏地裂。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen in the sixth month of the eighth year the earth split open at Goushi.
translations.idiomatic: Yanxi 8, sixth month, bingchen: the soil gaped at Goushi.

sentences.zh: 永康元年五月丙午，雒阳高平永寿亭、上党泫氏地各裂。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu in the fifth month of the first year of Yongkang the ground split at Gaoping Yongshou lodge in Luoyang and at Xuanshi in Shangdang—each place.
translations.idiomatic: Yongkang 1 (167 CE), fifth month, bingwu: twin fissures—one at the Yongshou pavilion in Luoyang, one at Xuanshi in Shangdang.

sentences.zh: 是时，朝臣患中常侍王甫等专恣。

translations.literal: At that time court officials worried that Regular Attendant Wang Fu and others acted wantonly.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers fretted over Wang Fu's unchecked eunuch faction.

sentences.zh: 冬，桓帝崩。

translations.literal: In winter Emperor Huan died.
translations.idiomatic: That winter Huan died.

sentences.zh: 明年，窦氏等欲诛常侍、黄山，不果，更为所诛。

translations.literal: The next year Dou Wu and the others wished to execute the regular attendants and the Yellow Gates but did not succeed; they were instead executed by them.
translations.idiomatic: Next year Dou Wu's coup against the regular attendants failed; the plotters were slaughtered instead. Manuscripts disagree on a single word in the source line, but every version describes the same reversal.

sentences.zh: 灵帝建宁四年五月，河东地裂十二处，裂合长十里百七十步，广者三十余步，深不见底。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year of Jianning, Emperor Ling, Hedong's earth split in twelve places; the cracks joined to a length of ten li one hundred seventy paces, the widest more than thirty paces deep, bottom not visible.
translations.idiomatic: Jianning 4, fifth month: Hedong opened twelve parallel chasms—over eleven li end to end, thirty paces across at the widest, depth lost in shadow.

sentences.zh: 和帝永元五年五月戊寅，南阳大风，拔树木。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin in the fifth month of the fifth year of Yongyuan, Emperor He, Nanyang had a great wind that uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: Yongyuan 5 (93 CE), fifth month, wuyin: a gale tore up Nanyang's forests.

sentences.zh: 安帝永初元年，大风拔树。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongchu, Emperor An, a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchu 1: gales ripped trees from the earth.

sentences.zh: 是时，邓太后摄政，以清河王子年少，号精耳，故立之，是为安帝。

translations.literal: At that time Empress Dowager Deng held the government; because the prince of Qinghe was young—in reputation still a clever child—therefore he was set up; this was Emperor An.
translations.idiomatic: The Deng dowager enthroned the young Qinghe prince, praising his precocity; he became Emperor An.

sentences.zh: 不立皇太子胜，以为安帝贤，必当德邓氏也；

translations.literal: She did not enthrone Imperial Son Sheng, holding that Emperor An was worthy and would surely repay the Deng clan with gratitude.
translations.idiomatic: She bypassed Prince Sheng, betting that An would reward the Dengs for the throne.

sentences.zh: 后安帝亲谗，废免邓氏，令郡具迫切，死者八九人，家至破坏。

translations.literal: Afterward Emperor An personally believed slander, deposed and dismissed the Deng clan, and ordered the commanderies to press them urgently—eight or nine died, families down to ruin.
translations.idiomatic: An later swallowed lies about the Dengs, purged them savagely, and left eight or nine dead—whole houses destroyed.

sentences.zh: 此为□也。

translations.literal: This was [lacuna in text].
translations.idiomatic: That was the retribution the text marks. (One character is missing in the received text.)

sentences.zh: 是后西羌亦大乱凉州十有余年。

translations.literal: Afterward the Western Qiang also threw Liangzhou into great chaos for more than ten years.
translations.idiomatic: Then the Qiang war convulsed Liangzhou for another decade.

sentences.zh: 二年六月，京都及郡国四十大风拔树。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year the capital and forty commanderies and kingdoms had great winds that uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchu 2, sixth month: forty jurisdictions lost trees to wind.

sentences.zh: 三年五月癸酉，京都大风，拔南郊道梓树九十六枚。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou in the fifth month of the third year the capital had a great wind that uprooted ninety-six catalpa trees along the southern suburban road.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchu 3, fifth month, guiyou: a wind sheared ninety-six catalpas from the processional avenue to the southern altar.

sentences.zh: 七年八月丙寅，京都大风拔树。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin in the eighth month of the seventh year the capital had a great wind that uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchu 7, eighth month, bingyin: Luoyang gales again.

sentences.zh: 元初二年二月癸亥，京都大风拔树。

translations.literal: On the day guihai in the second month of the second year of Yuanchu the capital had a great wind that uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanchu 2, second month, guihai: capital windthrow.

sentences.zh: 六年夏四月，沛国、勃海大风，拔树三万余枚。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer of the fourth year Pei and Bohai had a great wind that uprooted more than thirty thousand trees.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanchu 4, summer: Pei and Bohai counted thirty thousand trees down.

sentences.zh: 延光二年三月丙申，河东、颍川大风拔树。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen in the third month of the second year of Yanguang Hedong and Yingchuan had a great wind that uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: Yanguang 2, third month, bingshen: Hedong and Yingchuan gales.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，郡国十一大风拔树。

translations.literal: On the day renwu in the sixth month eleven commanderies and kingdoms had great winds that uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renwu: eleven provinces in a single storm.

sentences.zh: 是时，安帝亲谗，曲直不分。

translations.literal: At that time Emperor An personally believed slander; straight and crooked were not distinguished.
translations.idiomatic: An could no longer tell truth from slander.

sentences.zh: 三年，京都及郡国三十六大风拔树。

translations.literal: In the third year the capital and thirty-six commanderies and kingdoms had great winds that uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: Yanguang 3: thirty-six jurisdictions plus the capital.

sentences.zh: 灵帝建宁二年四月癸巳，京都大风雨雹，拔郊道树十围已上百余枚。

translations.literal: On the day guisi in the fourth month of the second year of Jianning, Emperor Ling, the capital had great wind, rain, and hail that uprooted more than a hundred trees ten arm-spans and more along the suburban road.
translations.idiomatic: Jianning 2, fourth month, guisi: wind, rain, and hail snapped over a hundred massive trees lining the sacred way.

sentences.zh: 其后晨迎气黄郊，道于雒水西桥，逢暴风雨，道卤簿车或发盖，百官沾濡，还，不至郊；

translations.literal: Afterward at dawn they welcomed qi at the yellow suburban altar; the road lay on the west bridge of the Luo—there they met a violent rainstorm; some canopy carriages in the procession had their covers torn off; the hundred officials were drenched; they returned without reaching the suburb.
translations.idiomatic: Later, at the yellow-suburb rite at dawn, a squall struck the Luo's west bridge—umbrella-chariots lost their hoods, ministers were soaked, and the cortège turned back without finishing the ceremony.

sentences.zh: 使有司行礼。

translations.literal: They ordered the responsible officials to perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: The court had ministers complete the ritual by proxy.

sentences.zh: 迎气西郊，亦壹如此。

translations.literal: Welcoming qi at the western suburb was exactly the same.
translations.idiomatic: The western-suburb ceremony failed the same way.

sentences.zh: 中平五年六月丙寅，大风拔树。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin in the sixth month of the fifth year of Zhongping a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongping 5 (188 CE), sixth month, bingyin: another windthrow.

sentences.zh: 献帝初平四年六月，右扶风大风，发屋拔木。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fourth year of Chuping, Emperor Xian, Youfufeng had a great wind that tore off roofs and uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: Chuping 4 (193 CE), sixth month: west of the capital, gales stripped roofs and timber.

sentences.zh: 中兴以来，脂夜之妖无录者。

translations.literal: Since the restoration none of the "fat-of-night" prodigies have been recorded.
translations.idiomatic: After Guangwu restored the Han, the annals list no more "midnight grease" omens.

sentences.zh: 章帝七八年间，郡县大螟伤稼，语在《鲁恭传》，而纪不录也。

translations.literal: In the seventh and eighth years of Emperor Zhang commanderies and counties had great stem-borers injuring the crops—the account is in the biography of Lu Gong, but the annals do not record it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang's mid-reign saw caterpillar plagues—Lu Gong's memoir treats them, though the basic annals omit the entry.

sentences.zh: 是时，章帝用窦皇后谗，害宋、梁二贵人，废皇太子。

translations.literal: At that time Emperor Zhang listened to Empress Dou's slander, harmed Worthy Ladies Song and Liang, and deposed the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang believed Dou's lies, destroyed the Song and Liang ladies, and cast down the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 灵帝熹平四年六月，弘农，三辅螟虫为害。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fourth year of Xiping, Emperor Ling, Hongnong and the three adjuncts suffered stem-borer pests.
translations.idiomatic: Xiping 4 (175 CE), sixth month: borers devoured the capital region's grain.

sentences.zh: 是时，灵帝用中常侍曹节等谗言，禁锢海内清英之士，谓之党人。

translations.literal: At that time Emperor Ling listened to Regular Attendant Cao Jie and others' slander, proscribed the pure and outstanding men of the realm within, calling them "factionists."
translations.idiomatic: Ling let Cao Jie brand the honest scholars as "partisans" and hunt them down.

sentences.zh: 中平二年七月，三辅螟虫为害。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year of Zhongping the three adjuncts suffered stem-borer pests.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongping 2 (185 CE), seventh month: the borers returned to the capital districts.

sentences.zh: 明帝永平十八年，牛疫死。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Yongping, Emperor Ming, cattle died in plague.
translations.idiomatic: Yongping 18 (75 CE): murrain wiped out the herds.

sentences.zh: 是岁，遣窦固等征西域，置都护、戊己校尉。

translations.literal: That year Dou Gu and others were dispatched to campaign in the Western Regions; a protector-general and the Wuji garrison colonels were established.
translations.idiomatic: The same year Dou Gu marched west and the court posted a protector-general and Wuji colonels.

sentences.zh: 固等适还而西域叛，杀都护陈睦、戊己校尉关宠。

translations.literal: When Gu and the others had just returned the Western Regions rebelled, killing Protector-General Chen Mu and Wuji Colonel Guan Chong.
translations.idiomatic: No sooner had the army withdrawn than the west rebelled—Chen Mu and Guan Chong fell.

sentences.zh: 于是大怒，欲复发兴讨，会秋明帝崩，是思心不容也。

translations.literal: Thereupon the court was greatly angered and wished to launch another great punitive expedition; it happened that in autumn Emperor Ming died—this is "reflective thought finding no room."
translations.idiomatic: Ming meant to strike again but died that autumn—Heaven cutting short a ruler who would not listen.

sentences.zh: 章帝建初四年冬，京都牛大疫。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fourth year of Jianchu, Emperor Zhang, the capital's cattle suffered a great plague.
translations.idiomatic: Jianchu 4 (79 CE), winter: cattle plague struck the capital herds.

sentences.zh: 是时，窦皇后以宋贵人子为太子，宠幸，令人求伺贵人过隙，以谗毁之。

translations.literal: At that time Empress Dou had the son of Worthy Lady Song as heir apparent, favored and beloved; she ordered people to seek out the worthy lady's faults and destroy her with slander.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dou's son sat as heir; she set agents to sniff out Lady Song's slips and ruin her with lies.

sentences.zh: 章帝不知窦太后不善，厥咎□也。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhang did not realize Empress Dowager Dou was not good—the blame [lacuna in text].
translations.idiomatic: Zhang never saw Dou's malice—the moral fault named in the text. (One character missing.)

sentences.zh: 或曰，是年六月马太后崩，士功非时兴故也。

translations.literal: Another view says that in that year in the sixth month Empress Dowager Ma died, and earthworks were raised out of season for that reason.
translations.idiomatic: Another gloss ties the plague to Ma's death that sixth month and the untimely corvée her tomb demanded.
